info.name: PortainerCE auth stacks API
stacks
List stacks

params.name: filters
params.description: Filters to process on the stack list. Encoded as JSON (a map[string]string). For example, {'SwarmID': 'jpofkc0i9uo9wtx1zesuk649w'} will only return stacks that are part of the specified Swarm cluster. Available filters: EndpointID, SwarmID.

items.docs:
List all stacks based on the current user authorizations.
Will return all stacks if using an administrator account otherwise it
will only return the list of stacks the user have access to.
Limited stacks will not be returned by this endpoint.
**Access policy**: authenticated
